correctness.rationale: The one-species exchange from an A-exclusive/B-exclusive pair exactly pairs all survivor subsets that differ in the two marked statuses. For each fixed four-region occupancy count the expectation increment is a single adjacent mixed difference with the explicitly calculated nonnegative integer multiplicity. This proves full supermodular order for every feasible finite n,k,a,b,c, including k=0 and k=n. Setting the test function to two quorum indicators isolates the sharp finite binomial increment. Inclusion–exclusion and Pascal’s identity prove the joint-activity covariance, monotonicity, and exact positivity criterion. Direct exact independent enumeration verified 45,078 quorum identities across 2,838 adjacent feasible overlaps through n=9 and the 7-species rational example. Enumerations do not replace the infinite-parameter proof.

originality.rationale: Within inspected ecological and probability sources the full fixed-budget partner-overlap stochastic ordering, its exact all-quorum transfer coefficient and strictness law, and its fixed-survival-budget negative-to-positive functional-activity covariance threshold were not stated or implied. Abstract supermodular-order theory provides the mathematical framework; its four-point characterization is a methodological predecessor but does not itself identify this specified hypergeometric family or construct the coefficients. Joag-Dev–Proschan negative association addresses disjoint sets and does not cover the overlapping-family order. Historical priority remains provisional because not every older probability/reliability source has been inspected.
residual_risks: An older exact dependence-order result for overlapping hypergeometric marginals or coherent-system reliability may have escaped indexed full-text search.
The Joag-Dev–Proschan primary full text was not reviewed, so equivalence contained in its results is not excluded.

Abstract supermodular order machinery is already published; the potential originality is the specific exact construction, fixed-budget ecological interpretation and sharp functional-activity transition, not the abstract order notion.
The scientific assumptions are idealized and do not justify real-world empirical forecasting.

value.rationale: The precise ecological problem is to understand whether conserving common primary species can increase simultaneous function persistence under a fixed-number loss protocol even though the two marginal function risks remain exactly equal. The all-parameter strictness formula gives a nonlocal structural comparison without needing a census of separate network designs, while the sharp covariance inequality identifies how competition induced by finite-population sampling is overturned by enough shared partners. In the natural 7-species/3-survivor/3-partner example, overlap one still has negative indicator covariance, overlap two is positive, which cannot occur in the same way under independent survival. This is a meaningful dependence/robustness boundary with plausible design use, rather than a table recomputation or merely a renamed probability identity.
